title: Lesional Evaluation of High Risk Patients With Neoatherosclerosis Treated With Rosuvastatin and Eicosapentaenoic Acid Using Optical Coherence Tomography(OCT)[LINK IT TWO]

sections.abstract: This study aim is to evaluate the additional effect of eicosapentaenoic acid and dose up effect of rosuvastatin for neoatherosclerosis in coronary artery disease patients.
